title: Graduate electrodynamics
purpose: Solve extended boundary and radiation problems using Green functions, multipoles and relativistic field methods.
primary_reading: David Tong Electromagnetism notes (use the supplements described in Section 12 for topics beyond the primary source.)

blocks.deliverable: Derive a solution representation from boundary data.
Calculate a multipole expansion with a convergence domain.
Derive an energy balance for the chosen material assumptions.
Week 7 midterm; solve an extended boundary problem.
Obtain a leading radiation or scattering estimate.
Translate a calculation into tensor notation.
Submit a derivation with checks; complete a graduate E and M exam.

project: Develop a boundary or radiation calculation with a stated error estimate for its approximation.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
